title: Jackie Brown
tagline: Cash, a mall, and a very good plan.
about: A flight attendant caught smuggling money plays the cops and a gun runner against each other.
cue: Serve the snacks when the money swap happens at the shopping mall.
faces: Help yourself to the trolley. I've had a long flight and a longer day.

    StartersHermosa Beach fish tacosLager battered fish strips in corn tortillas with cabbage and chipotle cremaHow to make it150g plain flour250ml lager500g flathead fillets150g sour cream1 chipotle in adobo2 limes12 corn tortillas1/4 cabbage1 L vegetable oilWhisk the flour and cold lager into a batter.Mix the sour cream with chipotle and lime juice to make crema.Shred the cabbage and cut the flathead into strips.Dip the fish in batter and fry in the vegetable oil at 180°C for 3 minutes.Serve in warm tortillas with cabbage, crema and lime wedges.Cabo flight lime chilli peanutsRoasted peanuts with lime zest, chilli and flaky salt, in little foil packetsHow to make it300g peanuts2 limes1 tsp chilli powder1 box sea salt flakesToss the peanuts with lime zest, chilli powder and flaky salt.Roast at 160°C, stirring once.Cool and fold into four little foil packets.Del Amo food court teriyaki skewersA Del Amo bag of cash, and a bag of beach towelsHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thigh glazed in sticky soy, ginger and mirin teriyaki, charred on skewers, with sesame, spring onion and pickled cucumber in paper food court boats.Simmer 80ml soy, 80ml mirin, 2 tbsp brown sugar and grated ginger for 4 minutes until syrupy.Thread 800g diced chicken thighs onto 12 skewers.Grill on high for 10 minutes, turning and brushing with the glaze in the last 4 minutes until sticky and charred.Slice a cucumber thin and toss with 2 tbsp rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar.Serve in paper boats with sesame seeds and spring onion.Mini croissants with ham and SwissJackie's galley tray. Hold the $50,000.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsMax Cherry's steak dinnerSeared sirloin, loaded baked potato and iceberg wedge with blue cheese dressingHow to make it4 potatoes4 sirloin steaks1 iceberg lettuce100g blue cheese300g sour cream1 bunch chivesBake the potatoes at 200°C for an hour.Cut the iceberg into four wedges and mash the blue cheese with some of the sour cream.Sear the steaks, pull at 54°C and rest.Spoon the dressing over the wedges and load the potatoes with sour cream and chives.Ordell's South Bay hot honey fried chickenOrdell, the Tec-9 and the AK-47How to make itAs written, serves 4Buttermilk-brined chicken fried shatter-crisp, drizzled with chilli hot honey, with smoky braised greens and a creamy baked mac and cheese.Brine 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tbsp hot sauce.Dredge in 300g flour with 2 tsp paprika and fry at 165°C until 74°C inside.Warm 4 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and drizzle over.Wilt 2 bunches kale with bacon and cider vinegar.Toss 300g cooked macaroni with 200g grated cheddar, 250ml milk and 1 egg and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.SweetsMax Cherry's walnut banana breadBanana loaf with walnuts.
